commits.subject: fix(plugins): serialize overlapping hook callback fires instead of dropping
commits.message:
fix(plugins): serialize overlapping hook callback fires instead of dropping

A second fire of a still-running bounded hook callback was returned
_HOOK_SKIPPED, dropping observer evidence (post_tool_call et al.) and
converting ordinary overlap into the pre_tool_call timeout block
directive (#104750). Serialize overlapping fires behind the running
invocation on a condition sharing _hook_timeout_lock, keeping the
no-concurrent-self guarantee; skip only once the peer is known hung
(peer timeout notifies waiters; otherwise one timeout + grace wait
deadline), re-arming suppression either way.
